description: This is a JUnit test class for the DelinquencyReadPlatformServiceImpl, testing the behavior of the method that enriches loan collection data with delinquency pause periods based on delinquency actions and business dates.

classes.name: DelinquencyReadPlatformServiceImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for DelinquencyReadPlatformServiceImpl, testing how delinquency pause periods are added to collection data based on delinquency actions and current business date.

methods.name: testNoEnrichmentWhenThereIsNoDelinquencyAction
methods.description: Verifies that no pause periods are added when there are no delinquency actions.

methods.name: testMultiplePausesWithoutResumeActionCurrentlyInPauseFirstDay
methods.description: Tests multiple pause actions and ensures correct pause periods when the current business date is on the first pause day.

methods.name: testMultiplePausesWithoutResumeActionCurrentlyInPauseLastDay
methods.description: Tests multiple pause actions on the last day of a pause period.

methods.name: testMultiplePausesWithoutResumeActionCurrentBusinessDateBetweenStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Checks pause periods when the current date falls between the start and end of a pause.

methods.name: testMultiplePausesWithoutResumeCurrentBusinessDateIsNotOverlappingWithAnyOfThePauses
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the current date is outside all pause periods, ensuring no active pause is marked.

methods.name: verifyPausePeriods
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the collection data contains expected pause periods.

methods.name: pausePeriod
methods.description: Creates a DelinquencyPausePeriod object with specified active status and date range.
